answers.falsifier: with HOME an empty directory, an owning intention that exists in the repo raises no owning_intention_resolves finding ; an owning intention that does not exist still raises owning_intention_resolves
answers.how: In cairn/tools/ticket_inspector/inspector.py replace CAIRN_ROOT = Path(os.path.expanduser('~/dev/src/cairn')) with ROOTS['repo'] (ROOTS is already imported there). Red-first proof cairn/tools/ticket_inspector/proofs/test_the_inspector_finds_the_repo_where_it_stands.py runs inspect_ticket in a child whose HOME is an empty scratch dir, so it reds on every host.
answers.title: ticket_inspector resolves an owning intention against the repo it stands in, not against ~/dev/src/cairn
answers.traces_to: Law 3: measured, an existing intention was reported unresolved from a HOME that does not hold the repo; Law 8: the proof reds on the unedited inspector on any host; Law 1: the repo has one address, ROOTS, and a second spelling of it is a defect.
answers.what: ticket_inspector's CAIRN_ROOT is the repo's own address, ROOTS['repo'] from cairn.tools.base.address, so owning_intention_resolves reads true for an intention that exists wherever the repo is kept.
